notes: Three-course shelf, the mid-ground structure of the reference. Each layer sets back and slides so the stack is not a wedding cake, and every layer gets its own convex hull — a single hull would fill the steps in and the kart would collide with open air above each one.

rules.placement: Mid-ground three-course shelf on hillside breaks; layers set back so steps stay walkable/collidable.
rules.avoid: Avoid wetland mud and dense forest floor clutter.
